# Relax

Relax components are included under Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE` and the source copyright notices.

The `rynn-rl-train` command uses the Hugging Face backend in `rynn_rl/`. The Relax modules require their own Megatron, SGLang, Ray and TransferQueue environment. See the top-level training and evaluation documentation for the supported command-line workflow.

Public upstream: https://github.com/redai-infra/Relax.
